title: Codespaces dashboard restored by starting the saved server task
summary: The owner reported HTTP 502 at the Codespaces forwarded dashboard port. A host-level request to local port 5174 failed to connect before startup. Running the saved DITO dashboard task started the Node server. Subsequent host-level requests returned HTTP 200 for GET /api/health with ok true and HEAD / with HTML content type. This verifies local server availability only; the owner's authenticated forwarded URL, DITO account requests, and payment flows were not exercised. The required live journal index and automatic-findings workflow document were absent at the initial read; the recorder's example and implementation supplied the schema.

evidence.description: Local/Codespaces setup requires the server task to remain running and to be started again after Codespace restart.
Node server serves the dashboard and local health endpoint on port 5174.
Forwarded dashboard page displayed HTTP 502; private screenshot and host address were not copied into the journal.
Connection refused before task startup; health GET and homepage HEAD both returned HTTP 200 after startup. No upstream DITO requests were made.

nextSteps: Refresh the existing private forwarded port URL and confirm it opens in the owner's browser.
Keep the DITO dashboard task running; start it again after the Codespace or server stops.
Restore the missing docs/06-AUTOMATIC-FINDINGS.md workflow document in the ongoing documentation work.
